title: How is Fidel Castro connected to Patrick Star?
description:
Two presidents, a Star Wars legend and a Hollywood ceremony connect Fidel Castro to Patrick Star, through the voice of Patrick, Bill Fagerbakke.

Fidel Castro → Enrique Peña Nieto → Joe Biden → Mark Hamill → Bill Fagerbakke → Patrick Star

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Fidel Castro → Enrique Peña Nieto: In 2014, Mexican president Enrique Peña Nieto visited Fidel Castro in Havana.
   Photo by PresidenciaMX 2012-2018, CC BY-SA 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Enrique_Pe%C3%B1a_Nieto_y_Fidel_Castro.jpg
2. Enrique Peña Nieto → Joe Biden: In 2016, Vice President Joe Biden flew to Mexico City for talks with Peña Nieto.
   Photo by The White House, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Joe_Biden_with_Enrique_Pe%C3%B1a_Nieto_in_Mexico_City.jpg
3. Joe Biden → Mark Hamill: In 2024, Star Wars legend Mark Hamill visited President Biden in the Oval Office.
   Photo by The White House, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P20240503AS-0590_(53783780087).jpg
4. Mark Hamill → Bill Fagerbakke: In 2025, Hamill joined the SpongeBob cast, including Bill Fagerbakke, at a Hollywood handprint ceremony.
   Photo by Getty Images for Paramount Pictures, via Mulderville, Fair use (commentary): https://mulderville.net/en/events/2990/the-spongebob-movie-search-for-squarepants-hollywood-honors-spongebob-squarepants-with-a-hand-footprint-ceremony
5. Bill Fagerbakke → Patrick Star: And Bill Fagerbakke has been the voice of Patrick Star since 1999.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore, Nickelodeon (NickRewind), CC BY-SA 3.0 / CC BY 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bill_Fagerbakke_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Patrick_Star_character.png

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#fidelcastro #patrickstar #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment: Who should I connect next? Two names, the weirder the better.
